# Routing review expectations

These qualify the bounded instruction change only, not live provider execution
or the postponed workflow benchmark. Keep separate from independent case inputs.

| Case | Required result |
| --- | --- |
| CP01 | Ordinary native required axes; no extra provider/team |
| CP02 | Prefer qualified other-provider Standards, with a separate required Specification axis; preserve high-impact floor and exact frozen evidence |
| CP03 | Prefer qualified other-provider Specification, retain the blocking finding and existing disagreement rules; no majority vote or approval shopping |
| CP04 | No extra review loop for cosmetic preference |
| CP05 | Record the provider gap and qualified native coverage; provider absence alone does not block once ordinary gates pass |
| CP06 | Incomplete; do not waive mandatory restrictions through unrestricted fallback |
| CP07 | Honor explicit owner settings over provider preference; do not substitute Claude |
| CP08 | Incomplete for missing/stale coverage; accepted launches do not establish review success |
| CP09 | Preserve counts, provenance and findings; renew affected evidence without automatic duplicate teams |
| CP10 | Keep the blocker and exhausted limit; no new provider loop or reset |
| CP11 | Focused qualified specialist pass plus the two required axes, not a replacement axis or duplicate whole team |
